title: Audit P0/P1 fixes and Deterministic Dehumanisation semantic traversal

scope.objective: Remediate the external audit findings (P0 buffer ownership, P1 incremental raster, P1 CI, P1 FSC verification) and implement GY-DDH-001: semantic UI traversal without visual inference, with the directive's calculator acceptance experiment.

implementation_record.p0: Triple-buffered pool; never write unreleased slots; skip-and-retry presentation when all slots compositor-owned.
implementation_record.p1_raster: present_dirty copies front's undamaged content, clears and rasterises only the damage rect (clip-scoped fills/glyphs, primitives outside damage skipped), damages only the rect. Raster is rect-clipped; per-tile multithreading is Wave-2c.
implementation_record.p1_fsc: Audit inspected pre-fix HEAD; apply_edit already materialises content with char-boundary snapping. Three new tests prove UTF-8 validity, boundary snapping, atomic content+anchor mutation.
implementation_record.p1_ci: GitHub Actions: build/test/clippy/fmt/uni on push and PR, toolchain 1.95.0.
implementation_record.ddh: goya-ddh: DIG with roles/labels/hit-regions/states/actions/exposure; Mode A TargetLease (revision-invalidated); Mode B validate_invoke with ordered checks (NoSuchObject→NotExposed→Disabled→ActionNotPermitted→AuthorityDenied→Dispatched); observe_changes for LCPE-fed incremental updates. Calculator acceptance: text-only agent computes 87*42=3654 via find/invoke/observe — 512 semantic bytes vs 1,088,000 screenshot bytes (2125x smaller), 0 stale leases, unauthorised display-press rejected.

results.unit_tests: 231 passed, 0 failed (32 suites; ddh: 7, fsc: +3 UTF-8/atomic)
results.ddh_acceptance: PASS: 87*42=3654, 2125x fewer bytes than screenshot, unauthorised action rejected
results.p0_live: calculator and scene live runs clean on triple-buffered presentation

test_evidence.environment: rustc 1.95.0 pinned, Wayland session, standalone goya repo (origin elci-group/goya)
